summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an October 19, 2026 news release on Q2 Fiscal 2027 operational results and the scheduled November 5, 2026 financial-results release. No transaction, shareholder action, or board decision is involved. Disclosed items include 213,320 tonnes processed at Ying, production declines of 41% silver, 34% gold, 42% silver-equivalent, 41% lead and 51% zinc year over year, and revenue of $72.1 million, down 13%, partly offset by higher realized metal prices. No special-situation angle; watch operational restart and El Domo construction risk.
